That makes sense because it's the first appearance of the Icehouse pyramids. So, Icehouse seems to have come out around 1989.

Then, the WebSurfer moved on to Kill Doctor Lucky. They checked multiple sources and found that it was released in 1996 by Cheapass Games. That’s pretty clear.

Now, comparing the two, Icehouse was released in 1989 and Kill Doctor Lucky in 1996. So, Icehouse came out first, about 7 years before Kill Doctor Lucky.

But wait, in the conversation, there was a point where the WebSurfer was looking for the exact edition year of Icehouse: The Martian Chess Set on BoardGameGeek. They found it listed as 1999. That's a bit confusing because earlier they mentioned 1989. Maybe there was a mistake in the source or the edition they looked at. If the 1999 edition is the one listed, that would mean Icehouse came out later than Kill Doctor Lucky, which is not correct.

So, the mistake here is that the WebSurfer might have focused on the 1999 edition of Icehouse instead of the 1989 one. That would lead to the wrong conclusion that Kill Doctor Lucky came first. Therefore, the error was in step 2 when the WebSurfer found the 1999 release year for Icehouse without verifying the earlier 1989 edition.
